slice: R2.6.15 fixture-backed VaultStore rename apply and rollback
status: accepted slice; R2 remains in progress
scope: Exercise every C03 rename fixture case through the filesystem-backed VaultStore transaction and verify rollback after an earlier reference write has committed.
behavior: The resolved fixture case contains references in two notes, allowing the transaction test to fail on the second note after the first reference update has been written.

The testkit materializes each fixture case in a temporary vault, applies VaultStore's rename preview, and checks exact resulting bytes, moved source paths, planned/skipped counts, warnings, returned note bytes, and prepared/committed journal entries.

The vault unit test injects a failure on Notes/Second.md, confirms Index.md was written and then restored, verifies all original bytes and the old source path are restored, and checks prepared/rolled_back journal entries.
No local executable validation was run; all executable validation used GitHub Actions.
